proposed_capability: P141 selected EA-index-first, deterministic no-motion-when-possible semantic reassessment; Fifth Gear P95/P82/P08/P07/P124 implements a portable, pure evidence-driven continuous camera gesture proposal with zero automatic game input. Replace speculative compass oscillation with one novel view and monotone easing only when required.
player_save_control_impact: No directory discovery, reads of protected saves, binary execution, EA hooks, game input or new daemon. An explicit supplied .package only is inspected read-only; all camera trajectories are advisory and require current independently authorized host ownership.
expected_outcome: Stable results on Linux/Windows/macOS and any installation directory, no movement for sufficient or stale evidence, deterministic one-view planning for proven new coverage, smooth monotone waypoints, no automatic back-and-forth.
negative_tests: Revised camera revision causes HOLD without movement
Candidates with no novel objects cause zero pan
Repeated input is byte-equivalent across directory layouts
Invalid/evasive paths and saves never opened
Invalid viewport and unsafe deltas fail closed
rollback_path: Revert feature branch or merged commit; default game and human ownership unchanged, no installation data migrated.
unresolved_unknowns: No current authorized local Sims runtime for P08
EA DBPF TGI indexes are not full building geometry decoders
Actual native game hook requires exact patch source
PR159 separate sensor writer remains independent
decision_rationale: P141 rejected linking to EA machine-code binaries or inventing 3D geometry from DBPF index keys; also rejected continuous compass loops and duplicate map stores. Chosen seam adds read-only file evidence and a zero-first, novel-view, continuous single gesture proposal alongside canonical lot and player-first architecture.
